title: Cardio Storm
description: HIIT and Tabata combo with squat jumps, high knees, skaters and mountain climbers to leave it all out there

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Side shuffles
exercises.instructions: Quick lateral shuffles, 3-4 steps each side

exercises.name: Moderate high knees
exercises.instructions: Knees to chest at a moderate pace

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate cat and cow, breathe

exercises.name: Squat jumps
exercises.instructions: Explosive squat with a maximum jump, absorb the landing

exercises.name: High knees
exercises.instructions: Run in place, knees above hip height, arms coordinated

exercises.name: Skaters
exercises.instructions: Lateral jumps from foot to foot, arms swinging

exercises.name: Star jumps
exercises.instructions: Jump spreading arms and legs into a star shape

exercises.name: Mountain climbers
exercises.instructions: In a plank, drive knees to chest alternating quickly

exercises.name: Flutter kicks
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, legs extended, quick alternating kicks

exercises.name: Toe touches
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, legs vertical, reach hands to touch the feet

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.instructions: Grab your foot behind you, knee toward the floor

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Hip 90/90
exercises.instructions: Seated, legs at 90 degrees, pivot from side to side

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.instructions: Kneeling, arms extended forward, forehead on the floor, breathe deeply
